svg.title: Zumo 32U4 front sensor array proximity sensors
svg.desc: Robot photograph © Pololu Corporation — pololu.com. Corrected from the user-provided full-canvas PNG with the original PNG payload preserved byte-for-byte. The highlighted right, front, and left detectors are proximity sensors; the separate downward-facing sensors are used for line sensing.

text.tspan: Right, front, and left proximity sensors
detect nearby objects to help the Zumo navigate.

g.text: Detects nearby objects to the right
Detects nearby objects to the left
